review_questions.question: CD4 count is nonspecific but in this cohort accompanies AIDS care. Recommend conservative V+HIV only as documented fixture policy or inheritance, not a claim that CD4 diagnoses HIV.
Stress, sleep disorder, social isolation/contact, and MMSE are not clearly psychiatric disorders. Conservative PSY tagging is possible but must be explicit; do not fabricate SNOMED ancestry.
Community violence/environment safety do not themselves identify sexual/domestic violence. Optional conservative SDV is a policy choice.

combination: Use confidentiality max N<R<V and sorted union of sensitivities. Parent containing components aggregates child labels. Components inherit panel baseline plus own code/value labels. Encounters include type AND reason labels to avoid exposed sensitive reason concepts.
